blocks.text: Digital economy (paison aur karobar ki duniya) mein cryptocurrencies aham hain kyunke yeh paisa badalne ka mehfooz aur decentralized tareeqa deti hain. Bankon ki jaari ki hui traditional (purane aam) raqam ke ulat, cryptocurrencies blockchain technology se transactions ko mehfooz aur transparent (saaf, sab ke saamne) rakhti hain. Yeh technology transactions ko aise record karti hai ke unhein badla na ja sake, aur kisi middleman (beech wala) ki zaroorat nahi parti.

Bitcoin, Ethereum aur doosri cryptocurrencies se log jaldi aur kam kharche mein paisa bhej sakte hain, sarhadon ke paar bhi. Yeh un logon ko bhi global economy (duniya bhar ka karobar) mein shamil hone mein madad deti hain jin ke paas bank ki sahoolat nahi. Cryptocurrency transactions cryptography se mehfooz hoti hain, lekin poori tarah private nahi: har transaction sab ke saamne record hoti hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab kehti hai ke cryptocurrency transactions private hain kyunke in mein personal information (zaati maloomat) nahi maangi jati. Yeh poori tarah sahi nahi: Bitcoin jaise blockchain par har transaction ek address (khaas code) ke saath public ledger (sab ke saamne khata) par record hoti hai; naam nazar nahi aata magar len den sab dekh sakte hain. Is ko 'pseudonymous' (farzi naam wala) kehte hain. Crypto ko rupay mein badalne wale exchanges aam tor par shanakht (ID) maangte hain. Cryptography wali hifazat ki baat sahi hai.

blocks.prompt: Cryptocurrencies ka ek faida aur ek khatra bataiye.
blocks.explanation: Faida: bank ke baghair, sarhad ke paar bhi, tez aur sasti transfer. Khatra: in ki qeemat tezi se oopar neeche hoti hai, aur agar key (password jaisi secret cheez) kho jaye ya dhoka ho jaye to paisa wapas nahi milta.

items: Cryptocurrencies: blockchain par decentralized, mehfooz aur transparent len den (Bitcoin, Ethereum).
Tez, sasti, sarhad paar; bank na rakhne walon ke liye bhi.
